name: OBJECTIVE_STRICT_OVERLAP_GROUPING_V1

definitions.exact_touch: a.end_utc = b.start_utc OR b.end_utc = a.start_utc; exact touch is not an automatic overlap edge
definitions.ordinary_eligible_task: Task has a complete current accepted operational plan, is not provider/local cancelled/terminal executable history, has no accepted start/protected membership lock that forbids restructure, has no unresolved same-activity competing-attempt block, and belongs to ordinary scheduling rather than the historical provider-Complete path
definitions.membership_interval: for current accepted Objective topology use objective_task_membership_current.accepted_plan_revision_id; never silently substitute a newer task_plan_current revision
definitions.desired_interval: for regroup calculation use current accepted task_plan_current interval when ordinary eligibility permits; a current membership pinned to an older plan therefore produces an explicit repin/move/consolidation diff

component_algorithm: materialize only compact tuples (task_id,start_utc,end_utc,current_plan_revision_id,current objective/membership revision/effective lock/risk flags) under one stable snapshot; preserve exact total separately
sort eligible tuples by (start_utc ASC,end_utc ASC,task_id ASC)
initialize current component with first tuple and component_max_end=end_utc

for each subsequent tuple: if tuple.start_utc < component_max_end, append to current component and component_max_end=max(component_max_end,tuple.end_utc); otherwise close current component and begin a new component
because component_max_end carries the farthest reachable end, the sweep computes transitive connected components of the strict interval-overlap graph without enumerating all pairwise edges
exact touch where tuple.start_utc == component_max_end begins a new component
component envelope is min member start and max member end
Customer Organization, root/subordinate RFC, unknown-customer and multi-context partitions are calculated after temporal components solely for explanation/warnings
current_objective_mapping: within each desired temporal component collect current nonsuperseded Objectives containing its Tasks and current Objectives whose envelopes strictly overlap the desired component envelope
zero current Objectives => propose create when ordinary automatic eligibility permits
one current Objective => compare exact current membership pins with desired current Task plan revisions; propose join/move/repin/envelope change as required
two or more current planned Objectives reached by one desired component => propose consolidation; accepted Objectives may not remain overlapping

consolidation survivor is deterministic lowest objective tracking_sequence among eligible existing planned Objectives, tie impossible under uniqueness; all other eligible planned Objectives become superseded rather than deleted
if component encounters terminal/historical Objective restructure need, do not manufacture a solution; classify GROUPING_INDETERMINATE/blocked conflict for review
in-progress Objective change is high-risk and limited to the exact command contract; algorithm never proposes moving/consolidating started protected work as ordinary acceptance
manual_exact_touch_merge: operator may explicitly request merge of exactly touching Objectives/Tasks
manual merge is not produced by the automatic strict-overlap graph
preview must include exact member/plan/objective revisions and prove the union will not strictly overlap any third current Objective
acceptance uses the same proposal persistence/revalidation path and preserves superseded Objective identities
competing_attempt_rule: distinct WFM TK identities are always distinct Tasks
only Tasks sharing the same reviewed activity_lineage_id are candidates for the one-active-attempt conflict

if two active WFM attempts in that lineage strictly overlap their current accepted operational intervals, mark WFM_COMPETING_ATTEMPT and exclude the ambiguous work from automatic regroup acceptance until reviewed
different reviewed activities under one RFC may group normally in the same Objective

proposal_fingerprint.serialization_order: version token; sorted affected task_id + task revision + current plan revision + desired interval + current membership objective/plan pin/revision + effective lock state + competing-attempt classification; sorted affected objective_id + objective revision + envelope revision + aggregate execution state; explicit manual-merge/reconsideration flag when applicable
excludes: Customer/RFC display labels that do not alter grouping authority
wall-clock time except an explicit eligibility classification captured as material input
proposal_fingerprint.rejection_rule: exact matching prior rejected input fingerprint suppresses automatic redisplay; only material fingerprint change or explicit reconsideration clears suppression

commit_revalidation: load proposal and all exact expected task/objective revisions in current UnitOfWork
recompute current plan/membership pins/effective locks/Objective execution state and material fingerprint
if mismatch return GROUPING_PROPOSAL_STALE before receipt/domain mutation
recompute requested resulting envelopes from proposed membership pins
query all current nonsuperseded envelopes outside affected/superseded set with indexed strict-overlap predicate
any unexpected overlap returns OBJECTIVE_OVERLAP and aborts
insert receipt, apply exact membership events/current pins and Objective creation/supersession, rebuild projections, rerun overlap guard, audit, commit

performance.time: O(n log n) for sorting + O(n) sweep
performance.memory: O(n) compact tuple/proposal working set; no workbook/source bodies
performance.forbidden: O(n^2) all-pairs overlap scan or a business maximum on number of Tasks per component
performance.large_workset: above bounds.json soft threshold use LLD-01 durable job with bounded pages/chunks for tuple extraction and proposal persistence; final component semantics remain identical
